answer: Sybil resistance comes from binding each agent identity to a hardware-rooted attestation of its MRENCLAVE, the enclave’s measured code. A verifier accepts only keys sealed to an approved enclave on genuine SGX or SEV hardware, with enrollment rules limiting identities per device; copying a VM or its files cannot reproduce the hardware-held key. Thus scaling identities requires additional physical silicon, while a gale of cloned images, a modified kernel, or a pulse of fresh virtual machines yields no valid new identities.
